profile.aboutTitle: Data engineering, software architecture, and delivery discipline are the center of my work.
aboutSummary: For data engineering teams, I bring experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines, automated reporting, schema-optimized relational databases, data quality checks, API integration, and reproducible deployment workflows.
For software architecture work, I connect databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, Linux environments, and stakeholder requirements into systems that are maintainable and usable.
My software foundation includes Python, SQL, Java, JavaScript, Flask, Node.js, Express.js, Java/JDBC interfaces, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS, Ubuntu, and testing/validation practices.
impactPoints: Career signal: 4+ years of technical delivery, a UBC M.Sc. Data Science GPA of 4.33, and a First Class Honours Computer Science GPA of 4.23.
Data engineering toolkit spans ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL stored procedures, schema design, indexing, data validation, Snowflake, automated reporting, and API integration.
Architecture toolkit spans REST APIs, database-backed applications, Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, Linux infrastructure, LDAP / Active Directory, and system validation.
Comfortable owning the path from messy operational requirements to tested data products, internal tools, dashboards, and production workflows.
profile.contactHeading: Open to data engineering, software architecture, and data platform roles.

projects.title: Carbon Emissions Tracking Pipeline
projects.desc: Production Python pipeline that captures, aggregates, and reports carbon emissions from PyTorch model training using live carbon intensity data.
projects.detail: Built during a UBC capstone with ALS Geoanalytics. The pipeline instruments training runs, ingests hourly regional emissions data, supports pruning and quantization measurement, and was containerized with Docker and maintained through GitHub Actions CI/CD. It benchmarked at roughly 85% measurement accuracy and tracked up to a 20% reduction in model training carbon footprint.
projects.impact: Production data pipeline, API integration, and emissions reporting
